changes.text: Home: "How past Top 10s did" above the Top 10. Replay of the rules since Jan 2025: share that beat the Nifty over 6 and 12 months and the average lead, next to the live Buys. Tap "How we know" for the full table, what helps and the limits

Buy tracking: "As one portfolio" card. All verified Buys held in equal weight vs the Nifty: growth of ₹100 chart (green while ahead, red while behind), points ahead, share of days ahead, worst fall from a peak, and Sharpe after 20 trading days
Home: Top 10 is first, as one ranked list (rank, industry and setup in words, price line, price and today's move); decision counts and a one-line funnel follow
Stock: the decision is the biggest thing on the page, with Claude's review, the reason in plain words, score and Top 10 rank; full company name; grouped by spacing
Digits line up everywhere (tabular numbers); small grey text is easier to read on the blue header; colour is kept for meaning (gains, losses, ratings) and blue for things you tap
Loading placeholders instead of a spinner, and a short 'Updated HH:MM' after each refresh

Request a full review: a request from a stock's Research section now queues Claude's full review (every number checked against the filing, debt with leases, related-party share, verdict), not a quick scan; one request a week per stock
Data screen: research runs take your requests and rule-Buys first; schedule lists the Sunday rules review
Buy tracking shows returns: each Buy is dated by the close it was entered at and measured from its entry price; calls opened and closed by same-day re-runs are removed
Tapping a sector in a rotation quadrant opens the stocks in its industries
Quality always uses the spectrum colours; turnaround is named, not shown in blue
Stocks with Claude's notes but no full review say 'Notes only' instead of 'Not studied'
Research queue: plain task names with one legend at the top, no rule text under every stock
Debt: lease liabilities filed under 'other liabilities' are now read; lease payments with no lease line raise a 'check leases' flag

Settings › Buy tracking: every verified Buy from the day it was rated, return now (or at exit) and vs Nifty, average, % beating Nifty, and the outcome mix vs the goal (2 multibaggers, 3 beat Nifty, 3 near, 2 losers per 10)
Settings › Version: installed version, update status and button, and release notes in one place (What's new and Check for updates merged)
IPO alerts is a switch; the Alerts page is removed (its push alerts were never set up)
Top 10 built as a portfolio: readiness order, at most 2 per industry, 3 per sector, 6 small caps; stays short rather than adding weaker stocks
Multibagger potential marked with a rocket on cards and the stock card
New Outlook triggers: results beat, analyst estimates upgraded, buyback or promoter buying, mutual funds entering; nearness to the 52-week high in the ranking
Top 10 order: leading or improving industries first, then live entry setups, then 60% momentum + 40% valuation, then score. Claude reviews candidates in the same order
Stock view: price chart first, with the 52-week low and high and where today's price sits

One small card for decision, Claude's review and score, with sector (Nifty index) and industry rotation: leading, improving, weakening or lagging. Tap it for every reason, Claude's review and the score

Trade setup in plain words: Breaking out, Dip in uptrend, Bottoming out, Wait or Avoid, drawn as a price line (buy zone, buy rest, exit, now, analyst target) with numbered steps. Position size and trailing exit removed
Claude's research: history of every scan and review, queue position and estimated run for a requested scan. Screener.in button removed
Announcements tab (last): every filing without a score, duplicates removed, filters for red flags, orders and growth, results
Tab names follow the swipe, so the open tab is always visible (feedback #62)
Rating tabs: no description line or legend; 'how the score works' under the scale; › only on lines that open a formula or filing
Home: Good outlook section (outlook score 55+ from verified research, not rated Sell, no failed review); stock cards sized to their content
Data updates automatically: the app checks for newly published data each time you return to it (every 15 minutes at most); no Refresh tap needed
Claude's review on every stock's Summary: verdict (pass / caution / fail), summary, checks verified, or its place in the review queue with an estimated run, or 'Not studied by Claude' (feedback #65)
Review markers beside the rating on cards and lists: tick = reviewed (coloured by verdict), hourglass = in Claude's queue, circle = rules only
Settings: Data pipeline, Data sources and Refresh data merged into one Data screen with today's jobs, sources (tap for coverage) and the last 30 runs (feedback #67)
Data sources updated: prices from NSE and BSE end-of-day files, BSE results and announcements, auditor's opinion, use of raised funds, named broker targets
Rating pills: text centred (feedback #61)
Quality and other level tabs: passed checks shown with a green tick, not blue (feedback #66)

Home: Open IPOs shown as cards in the same size and layout as stock cards (GMP, QIB/NII/Retail subscription, rating, action); IPOs opening later are greyed. Tap a card for its own window with all details and sources
Top 10 for today includes open IPOs rated SAFE with an APPLY call and at least 2× overall subscription, shown first
IPO alerts on this phone: 09:15 and 15:00 IST on an IPO's last day when the call is APPLY, or when the 14:10 NSE subscription update changes the call. Settings: IPO alerts On/Off
Refresh data: shows the data date and finish time in IST, the next update time, and says 'Already latest' when nothing new was published
Data pipeline: schedule of every job with its IST time
Recent IPOs section removed
Home: Decision view shows all 5 boxes without scrolling, equal size, count on top and decision below (feedback #59)
Calendar: checkpoint card now in Ocean blue (feedback #60)

Home: Open IPOs · 08:30 check. Only IPOs open for subscription at the check, with last date to apply, FINAL DAY flag, same-day GMP (range when sources differ), implied listing and GMP %, category subscription, key risk, rating and action; later-today and later-this-week IPOs listed unranked
Data pipeline: Data issues section. Wrong numbers found by Claude's audits, marked systemic or stock-specific, open or fixed

Verification gate: every Buy / Strong Buy is independently audited by Claude against the filing before it is shown as buyable; Verified badge, 'verification pending' otherwise; audit caution or fail turns it into Hold
Top 10 stocks for today shows only verified Buys
Automatic consistency checks on each stock page (finance cost vs debt, ROCE vs ROE, too-cheap valuation, one-quarter profit jumps, missing leases)
Debt now includes lease liabilities (ROCE, EV/EBITDA, net debt); Good or Excellent quality needs 3 years of full-year results
App logo in headers; decision view as wide one-line boxes; Top 10 opens its full list; empty sections hidden; equal-size stock cards without the 52-week line (#43-#47)
Charts green when up, red when down, on cards and stock pages (#48)
Money: no subtitle, mood score shown on the needle, extra text removed (#49, #50)
Feedback: tap Open or Closed, filter by type (#51)
Data pipeline: schedule of automatic jobs; Refresh data shows the last 30 pipeline runs; Alerts explains what you are notified about; Data sources in a detailed, standard layout (#52, #56, #57, #58)
Calendar uses the app background; research queue without the explainer, reasons in sentence case (#53, #54, #55)
Ocean blue theme (#42)

Home: Top 10 stocks for today (Buy-rated, ranked by 6 setup conditions), Recent IPOs; Watchlist and Not enough data removed; Beaten-up quality after Undervalued quality; Quality, priced in last; equal decision boxes without Not rated (#34, #35, #36, #37)
Money: industries in Money flowing in open their stocks; top picks = Buy-rated stocks in leading industries (#38, #39)
Settings: same-size cards that open their own screens; new Data pipeline screen with stage times, problems, source sizes and check coverage (#40, #41)
Formula sheets: inputs show full names with units (e.g. Market capitalisation ₹4,186.24 cr) instead of data keys; Formula / Inputs / Source headings in normal case
Home: removed the Screener link, bar colour legend, Claude line and the checkpoints list (#23, #24)
Dock: quick sliding highlight when switching tabs (#25)
Money: four tappable quadrant boxes with counts replace the map; money-flowing-out section removed; top picks in rising industries open the full list (#26, #27, #28)
Settings: feedback shows open and closed counts; Send feedback row removed (it is on every screen) (#29, #33)
Research queue text matches the current schedule; Screener and Settings use the app background (#30, #31, #32)
In-app update: the APK downloads inside the app with a progress bar, is checked for completeness, then opens the installer (no browser)
Stock pages and charts open instantly from the phone copy, then refresh to today's data
Icons instead of text symbols for warnings, risks and growth triggers
Bigger tap areas for stock tabs and screener chips

Data: delivery %, surveillance, index membership, shareholding (institutions, mutual funds, retail holders, pledge), dividends, preferential issues, promoter-side loans and promoter trades now feed the checks
Stock pages and charts always load today's data; the phone copy is used only when offline (stale detail showed Watchlist and Conviction unverified on DEEPINDS)
The profile tag no longer contradicts the decision: a Sell or Strong Sell stock cannot be tagged Prime candidate, Early story or Undervalued quality

Decision view: Strong Buy, Buy, Hold, Sell, Strong Sell (or Not rated until research finds a forward driver). Rule-built from filed numbers and quote-checked research, every reason listed on the stock page
Decision counts on Home (tap to list) and a decision filter in the screener; decision chip on cards and lists
Level 1 renamed Stability (tiers: Rock solid, Strong, Steady, Fragile, Distressed)
Claude research now works from GitHub-prepared packs: forward drivers, guidance, promises, kill switches and red-flag reviews
Stocks without a promoter group (many banks) no longer get promoter points: promoter checks show 'not applicable' and the score uses the checks that apply (#9)
Promoter trend and dilution merged into one Ownership check (#17)
Every level shows how many checks it was scored on and how the score works (#18)
Overall score shown on cards, lists and the stock page, with how it is built; sort by score (#13, #7)
Search bar on Home across all stocks (#14)
Research queue screen in Settings: what Claude scans next and why (#15)
Beaten-up quality: quality stocks 40%+ below their 52-week high that are back above the 50-day average; Home section and screener preset (#19)
Rotation map without clutter: tap a quadrant to see its industries, tap an industry for its stocks (#12, #6)
Screener filters folded into one Filters button; categories stay on top (#10)
Home and Money use the full-screen gradient (#5, #11)
Promoter holding as a chart (#16)

8 red-flag checks now filled for every NSE company from 24 months of exchange announcements: loan default, insolvency, rating downgrade or withdrawal, regulator order or penalty, search or fraud, statutory auditor resignation, CFO + CEO exits, leadership changes
A flagged check shows the filing date and subject with an 'Open filing' link. Flags come from the subject line only, so they are marked watch, never an automatic removal
Filed financials now cover 1,919 of 2,532 companies (was 549); the daily update runs in about half the time

New 7-level funnel: Company survivability, Business quality, Business valuation, Management evaluation, Momentum analysis, Discovery stage, Future outlook. Every level has 5 colour-coded tiers and a rubric of checks

Rule-built verdict for every stock (Prime candidate, Early story, Undervalued quality, Momentum play, Quality priced in, Value watch, Watchlist) with a one-paragraph statement made from the checks, no AI text
Stock screen: Summary plus one swipeable tab per level. Summary has the chart, funnel ratings, analyst target (only when one exists), 8 key ratios, standouts and the trade setup

Valuation by business type: banks and NBFCs on P/B vs ROE, cyclicals on mid-cycle EBITDA, loss-makers on EV/sales, others on P/E or EV/EBITDA, against own history, peers and the growth the price implies

Event watch on researched stocks: every exchange announcement is stored and typed (red: default, insolvency, auditor exit, raid, regulatory action, fraud, downgrade, pledge invoked, CFO/CEO/MD exit; green: orders, capacity, approvals, upgrades, corporate actions). New red or green filings, due must-go-right / kill-switch dates and price shocks send the stock back to Claude for a re-check. Shown under Outlook > Announcements; red filings in the last 45 days also show on Summary
Entry setups: Breakout, Pullback or Base, with stop, add-above level, size for 1% risk and reward/risk to the analyst target. Flags when the entry is above the target
Home: wave funnel from Listed to Outlook with counts, then verdict sections with 7-level colour bars on each card

Money movement: market mood index (0-100, fear to greed) from India VIX, Nifty vs 200-day, breadth, 52-week highs/lows and advance/decline, plus the rotation map, money flowing in and out, and top picks in rising industries
Screener: filter by minimum tier on any level, discovery stage, setup, market cap, industry; show removed stocks with the level and reason; save filters
Scan button shows its state: Request deep scan, Request full scan, Refresh scan, Scan queued, or scanned recently
Settings: what's new, updates, checkpoint calendar with verdict changes, everything you sent from this phone, data sources
Old exclusion rules (thin margin, penny, illiquid, already ran, broken trend) no longer remove stocks; only the funnel levels do, and missing data never removes
App crashed on launch (a colour helper called itself in a loop)
Home has two modes: Top-down (sector and industry rotation map, best value stock in each rising industry) and Bottom-up
Bottom-up short term: trend turning up plus analyst consensus 20%+ above price, with broker count and freshness
Long-term sections: Undiscovered value, Beaten-up value, GARP, Multibagger potential, Hidden value
Stock Summary tab: scorecard, hidden-value metrics, analyst consensus (only when it exists), Bull/Base/Bear for scanned stocks
Every financial number is computed from company filings on NSE; tap any value to see its formula, inputs and the filing. A dash means it could not be computed
Feedback and deep-scan requests are sent from inside the app
No market-cap upper limit; trade bands no longer show a computed target
Undervalued lens ranks by overall score and skips P/E below 5 (one-offs and distressed stocks)
Timeline dates show as month and year (e.g. May '26)
Results checkpoints show the announced board-meeting source instead of the SEBI deadline
Update popup lists only changes since your installed version
First release: Home lenses, Discover, stock page with entry and exit bands
Promises vs actuals timeline with verified source quotes
Upcoming checkpoints, memory of dropped stocks, excluded lookup
Feedback button on every screen and in-app update check
